scope: Ten highest-star selected product benchmarks discovered for meeting capture, notes, speech-to-text, and live meeting assistance. Adjacent and source-available products are explicitly classified. Not a universal all-GitHub ranking or an SEO rank.

method.query_order: sort=stars&order=desc; first 50 or 100 results per query
method.issues: Latest 100 issue/PR records per repository; PRs excluded in reviewed titles. Additionally first 100 open issues sorted by reactions for focused meeting products. Selected issue bodies and comments fetched directly.
limitations: Search cap and keyword coverage can miss candidates.
Star counts measure interest, not active use or quality.
Open issue does not prove bug is present in latest release; closed issues and code were not exhaustively audited.
Maintainer tickets and third-party integration pitches are not independent customer votes.
Disabled issue tracker prevents backlog conclusions.
Feature claims reflect primary docs rather than installed-app verification.
method.content_retention: Issue metadata and comment URLs/timestamps are retained verbatim. Bodies were read locally; SHA-256 fingerprints and lengths are saved instead of reproducing third-party text.
